description: Source code implementing wrapper functions for RWByteAddressBuffer Load/Store operations in HLSL, including functions for load, store, length, and atomic memory operations, with class and method definitions related to shader storage block functions.

classes.name: ShaderStorageBlockFunctionHLSL
classes.description: Class providing static methods to generate shader storage block functions for HLSL, including load, store, length, and atomic operations, and managing registered functions.

methods.name: OutputSSBOLoadFunctionBody
methods.description: Generates the body of the load function for shader storage buffer objects based on the type and layout.

methods.name: OutputSSBOStoreFunctionBody
methods.description: Generates the body of the store function for shader storage buffer objects based on the type and layout.

methods.name: OutputSSBOLengthFunctionBody
methods.description: Generates the body of the length function for unsized shader storage buffer objects.

methods.name: OutputSSBOAtomicMemoryFunctionBody
methods.description: Generates the body of atomic memory functions (add, min, max, etc.) for shader storage buffer objects.

methods.name: registerShaderStorageBlockFunction
methods.description: Registers a shader storage block function with specific parameters and returns its function name.

methods.name: shaderStorageBlockFunctionHeader
methods.description: Outputs the header declarations for all registered shader storage block functions.
